result.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('vpc',(SELECT to_jsonb(v) FROM network_vpcs v WHERE vpc_id='vpc_af937bb766324a5a8a41a08d55c39062'),'operations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',operation_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'completed_at',completed_at)) FROM network_operations WHERE vpc_id='vpc_af937bb766324a5a8a41a08d55c39062'),'base_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_vpc_base_connectivity WHERE vpc_id='vpc_af937bb766324a5a8a41a08d55c39062'),'eip_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_eips WHERE system_owner_vpc='vpc_af937bb766324a5a8a41a08d55c39062'),'snat_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_snat_bindings WHERE system_owner_vpc='vpc_af937bb766324a5a8a41a08d55c39062'));
